page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top above the text. Below it a block of marginal citations (full width, italic, small). Then heading SECTIO QUINTA, sub-heading CAPUT PRIMUM, a numbered list of six questions with hanging indents, then numbered paragraph 1 starting with a large initial, running to the foot of the page. No margin notes beside the text.

main_text.p: Bald. apud Gilken. ad init. tit. Cod. de summ. Trinit. n. 90. Coren Observat. Cur. Holland. 37, p. 294. 295. ibique Mascard. & alii.
main_text.head: SECTIO QUINTA
CAPUT PRIMUM.
main_text.p: 1. Utrum Princeps statuta condat super iis quae jure divino sunt introduc-ta?
2. Utrum recte statuta condat de negotiis mere ecclesiasticis?
3. An statuto fiat licitum quod aliter in conscientia est illicitum?
4. An statuta recte condantur, circa ea quae spectant jus naturale, & gentium primaevum?
5. An statutum valeat super negotiis, de quibus abunde jure civili cautum est?
6. An statuta valeant, quae condita contra jus civile?
1. POst explicatas difficultates quae naturam, id est definitionem, & divisiones statutorum, spectabant; ordo me deducit, ad obiecta statutorum; id est ut de rebus

page.notes: The large initial P is printed as a woodcut-style letter; read as "POst" with the initial joined. The running head and the marginal citation block are both printed at the top; the citation block is set as a foot-type block above the section heading. The list numbers are printed in a bold roman with a dot.
